profile.name: Flood Sung
profile.role: AI Researcher. Robotics Founder. Agent Systems Builder.
profile.summary: Founder & CEO of XVI Robotics, focused on general-purpose humanoid robot brain systems. Research spans reinforcement learning, meta-learning, few-shot learning, agentic intelligence, and multimodal foundation models.

research.title: Few-Shot & Meta-Learning
research.body: Relation Networks and meta-critic methods for learning from limited supervision and improving transfer.

research.title: Reinforcement Learning
research.body: RL for reasoning, planning, formal proof, code generation, and long-horizon agent behavior.

research.title: Foundation Agents
research.body: Open agentic intelligence, computer-use agents, multimodal models, and tool-using systems.
